description: This file defines the ScannerFragment class for an Android application, which scans for nearby Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) advertisements, filters them based on a specific service UUID, and displays the results in a list. It handles starting/stopping scans, managing scan callbacks, and UI interactions.
external_files: R (resources class, e.g., R.string.* and R.menu.scanner_menu)
Constants.Service_UUID (a UUID constant used for filtering scans)

classes.name: ScannerFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that manages BLE scanning, displays results in a list, and provides UI controls to initiate scanning.

methods.name: setBluetoothAdapter
methods.description: Sets the local BluetoothAdapter and initializes the BluetoothLeScanner.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets options menu, and creates the adapter and handler.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment view and sets the list adapter.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes list view appearance, sets empty text, and starts scanning initially.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions, specifically to trigger startScanning.

methods.name: startScanning
methods.description: Begins BLE scan, sets a timeout to stop after SCAN_PERIOD, and shows a toast.

methods.name: stopScanning
methods.description: Stops BLE scanning and updates the display.

methods.name: buildScanFilters
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of ScanFilter objects filtering by a specific UUID.

methods.name: buildScanSettings
methods.description: Creates and returns ScanSettings configured for low power mode.
